summary: Iteration 4 (v1.4) full-stack testing: Landing page routing, modular backend routes (analytics/plugin/reseller/license_client), standalone License Server on :8002, Reseller portal with JWT auth + subaccounts + scoped data. Backend: 28/28 new pytest cases PASS. Frontend: All required data-testids present and functional on Landing (/), Panel (/panel/licenses with LicenseServerStatus widget showing 'Erişilebilir'), and Reseller portal (/reseller). Legacy /licenses correctly redirects to /panel/licenses. All CTAs route correctly (buy→/shop, demo→/panel, reseller→/reseller). Reseller login (reseller@test.com/strong123), sub-account creation, listing, and logout all working. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: For license with no allowed_ips, first heartbeat auto-registers IP silently (bootstrap). This is intended per code comments but not idempotent-safe against hostile first-caller; consider requiring seller pre-registration or a first-run token.

Returns the doc after insert_one without popping _id explicitly before insert; the `doc.pop('_id', None)` runs but response depends on Motor returning the mutated dict. Currently works but fragile — safer to build response dict from known fields.

issues: Karantina empty-state table has large empty vertical space when 0 records; consider more compact empty state.

License-server-status widget is on a very information-dense page; scroll depth is significant. Consider moving to a dedicated 'System Health' section or collapsing older 'Lisans İhlalleri' table by default.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~2278 lines — the include_router modularization is a good start but ~65% of the code is still monolithic. Continue extracting quarantine/lists/checkout/rules/notifications/i18n into routes/*.py.

routes/reseller.py: JWT secret defaults to 'gws-reseller-dev-secret-change-me' if RESELLER_JWT_SECRET env is not set (which it currently isn't in backend/.env). This is a security risk in production. Set RESELLER_JWT_SECRET in .env and fail-fast (raise on startup) if missing in seller mode.
routes/reseller.py: Plan quota map {starter:5, pro:50, enterprise:999} is duplicated in `me` and `add_sub`. Extract to a module constant.
routes/license_client.py: `httpx.AsyncClient` is created per-request; consider a module-level singleton client (or FastAPI lifespan-managed) for connection pooling.
license-server/server.py: No rate-limiting on /v1/heartbeat or /v1/verify — a malicious plugin could flood violations. Add simple in-memory rate limit per (license_key,ip).

license-server/server.py: `datetime.fromisoformat(lic['valid_until'].replace('Z','+00:00'))` — if valid_until is missing or non-string, entire branch is silently swallowed by try/except pass. Log a warning at least.
Reseller portal has no password-reset flow yet — plan for v1.5.
License server exposes CORS=* — since it accepts revoke on POST it should restrict origins (revoke is admin-key gated so acceptable, but health/verify from any browser is fine).

success_rate.backend: 100% (28/28 new v1.4 tests) — includes 7 license-server, 2 proxy, 10 reseller auth/sub, 4 regression
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all landing/panel/reseller data-testids present, all navigation flows working, sub-account add + logout verified live
